findings: Self-hosted/colo authoritative DNS command construction validates provider-neutral DNS zone create requests and rejects provider-DNS-zone drift before emitting commands or receipts.
Targeted unit tests cover command shape, provider receipts, provider-DNS-zone drift, invalid DNS shape, invalid config, and absence of credential fields.
Site, cell, fabric, endpoint, DNS command path, and evidence refs live in the self-hosted adapter crate; the domain owns only the additive provider kind plus provider-neutral DNS port contract.
Adapter command bodies contain DNS resource references and tenant metadata, not private keys, tokens, or live credentials.
ChangeSet is isolated to one existing adapter crate, one additive provider kind, product/plan status, and evidence.
Avoids claiming IP-003 or FD-001 complete; CDN, remaining second-provider LB/interconnect adapters, and credentialed live smoke remain pending.
Oya VCS claim/work accepted before writes; promotion remains through verify/done/promote.
FD-001 evidence, multispectrum evidence, and audit-chain row identify the same ChangeSet id.
Kept self-hosted/colo DNS special cases in the existing adapter crate instead of branching provider logic through domain/API code.
No CoreDNS client, cloud SDK, or runtime network dependency was introduced in this request-contract slice.
The slice improves provider independence by proving a first-class on-prem/colo authoritative DNS target behind the same provider-neutral DNS zone port used by OCI DNS.

F3_adversarial.diagnostic_asserted: Provider DNS-zone drift, missing public-zone DNSSEC, invalid site/cell/fabric config, and credential leakage are rejected or absent before adapter receipts are emitted.
findings: Tests exercise provider-DNS-zone drift rejection, DNSSEC validation, invalid config, and absence of private_key/token in adapter command contracts.
Adapter constructor mirrors the VPC adapter endpoint/site/cell/fabric configuration and returns inspectable command structs for handler integration and tests.
Deterministic self-hosted DNS command structs follow the existing OCI/self-hosted adapter lint/test pattern without adding dependencies.
Rejected adding live CoreDNS/PowerDNS clients in this ChangeSet; deterministic request contracts keep credentialed live smoke as a later bounded slice.
Rejected treating self-hosted DNS as prose-only doctrine; added a first-class adapter implementation and provider kind behind the existing port.
Request translation is deterministic string assembly with no network call or runtime SDK client.
Catalog, architecture-boundaries, data-class, planning, honest-claims, and targeted Rust gates passed for the self-hosted DNS adapter contract.
IP status intentionally says live-smoke and remaining second-provider network surfaces pending, preventing a false FD-001 production-readiness claim.

known_gaps.reason: This slice proves adapter port and provider command contracts without embedding self-hosted control-plane credentials or making network calls in CI.
CDN, remaining second-provider LB/interconnect adapters, and live provider smoke remain outside this rollback-safe DNS slice.
